name: Split Kanban Component
description: The original user is requesting to break down the Kanban component into smaller, more manageable components for better maintenance and readability. An important aspect is to maintain consistency in naming conventions, props types, reactive data and methods among all Vue components. The provided example includes a main container `KanbanContainer.vue` which fetches kanbans from a global store or API call etc., a list component (`KanbanList.vue`) to render multiple kanban boards, a task card component (`TaskCard.vue` and `TaskCardLite.vue`), and an individual chat view component(`ChatViewVue`). The goal is to reduce complexity by splitting components into smaller units and make it easier to manage over time.
